howToPlay: Use the bouncing attack to hit enemies behind cover and control the field. Place the home base strategically to deploy robo-porters that harass opponents. Use gadgets and star powers to reinforce these porters or boost attack damage.
gears: Recommended gears are DAMAGE for offensive pressure, PET POWER to enhance your robo-porters, and SHIELD for extra survivability.
trait: Mr. P suits players who prefer a calculated, tactical style focused on area denial and persistent pressure.
